prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Welcome Card Layout Redesign: Redesign the initial story screen layout to a structured card layout to clearly introduce the pet companion universe before path selection.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Universe", "body": "Discover how your companion lives right on your desktop. Choose how you want to interact and start your journey."}}
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Photo Selection Preview Flow: Add an interactive photo preview component flow within the photo upload screen allowing real-time preview of pet rendering before submitting.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"components": [{"type": "photo_picker", "label": "Select Pet Photo", "action": "choose", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "preview", "label": "Companion Rendering Preview", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
2: [sign_in, redesign] Account Recovery & Sync Sign In Redesign: Redesign the sign-in options section to emphasize existing pet account synchronization and cloud save protection.
   config: {"sign_in": {"replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"type": "text", "text": "Sign in to securely sync and restore your pets across all desktop installs.", "style": "highlight", "role": "sign_in_options"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Continue & Sync Pets", "action": "next", "style": "emphasis", "role": "sign_in_options"}]}}}
3: [home, new_screen] Desktop Setup Preparation Waiting Screen: Insert a desktop display environment check screen before waiting to ensure system layer compatibility before companion creation finishes.
   config: {"new_desktop_prep": {"headline": "Preparing Desktop Environment", "body": "Checking display permissions and rendering overlay to ensure your companion appears seamlessly on top of windows.", "layout": "centered"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_desktop_prep", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Flexible Choice Copy: Reassure users on the choose_path screen that their selected path can be changed at any time later in settings.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Pick Your Companion Path", "body": "Choose how your pet will assist you. Don't worry—you can switch your path anytime in settings.", "hint": "You can change paths later without losing progress."}}
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Clarity Guidance Hint: Provide clear photo quality guidelines directly under the photo picker to prevent failed custom pet generations.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best pet rendering results, upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward with minimal background clutter."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Generation Time Remaining Wait Info: Display a live time estimate and processing progress details on the waiting screen so users know their pet is generating.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "body": "Your companion is being brought to life on your desktop. This usually takes under 3 minutes."}}
7: [finish, layout] Compact Quick Controls Home Intro Layout: Change home_intro layout to compact style featuring instant hotkey reference for summoning, hiding, and talking to the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Your Companion is Ready on Desktop!", "body": "Use Ctrl+Pet to open controls, double-click to interact, or right-click to hide your pet anytime."}}
8: [choose_path, incentive] All-Paths Companion Unlocks Incentive: Add a prominent badge component showing that all starter items and companions are unlocked regardless of chosen path.
   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "All companions & items included free on all paths!", "style": "playful"}]}}
9: [home, notification] Desktop Readiness Notification Alert: Enable desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the story screen while still introducing the pet companion universe.
Adds an interactive rendering preview within the photo upload onboarding step.
Redesigns the sign-in options while retaining the sign-in functionality.
Adds a valid system check screen within onboarding without removing any required steps.
Updates choose_path copy to clarify path flexibility without violating copy pricing rules.
Adds clear quality guidance hints to photo upload within onboarding.
Displays progress and real time estimate on the waiting screen while keeping its core job.
Redesigns the home intro layout within onboarding bounds.
Onboarding copy explicitly mentions 'free', which violates Rule 3.
Adds a notification toggle on the waiting screen during onboarding.
